title: How This 22-Year-Old Got Himself Arrested
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 7th, 2022. A mom called police on her son due to him coming back home drunk & naked. When police tried questioning him, he wasn’t making  much sense and couldn’t explain how he ended up naked or how we got home without his car. After getting checked out by ems, police asked the man to remain in his house and get rest however he refused to listen and tried leaving his house several times before Police decided to arrest him. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
